findings.label: Split commit state
findings.detail: Commit be1ec7e references palette.gutter and palette.chrome_style, which exist only in uncommitted working-tree Phase 1 changes, so the commit alone will not compile. The full reviewable state is commit + working tree together. Owner should stage/commit Phase 1 with Phase 2 so history is bisectable.

findings.label: Unrelated renames bundled in the commit
findings.detail: crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/tests_menu_workspace.rs in the Phase 2 commit carries ~30 handle_command -> dispatch_command_string edits and a menu_bar_has_help_and_excludes_terminate_option rename belonging to CR-CH-052 / dispatch-unify, not the theme work. No effect on theme behaviour; consider separating.

findings.label: Light body fg deviates from literal base00 (documented)
findings.detail: Brief lists Light fg as base00 #657B83, but body/chrome fg is #4E5F64 (deepened base01). The literal base00-on-base3 pair is 4.13:1 (independently recomputed), below AA; the deepening is required by Req 23.11 and documented. base00/base01 retained for the >=3:1 muted/UI roles. Correct resolution of the 18.3 vs 23.11 tension.
